properties.name: mes.plant.zone-id
properties.description: Time zone of the plant, used to resolve shift times. Defaults to 'America/Mexico_City'.

properties.name: mes.mqtt.enabled
properties.description: Whether the MES connects to the MQTT broker and ingests shop-floor messages.

properties.name: mes.mqtt.client-id
properties.description: Fixed MQTT client id. Must stay stable across restarts so the broker keeps the persistent session.

properties.name: mes.mqtt.subscription-topics
properties.description: Topic filters the MES subscribes to with QoS 1.

properties.name: mes.mqtt.dead-letter-topic
properties.description: Topic where rejected messages are published with the reason.

properties.name: mes.mqtt.qos
properties.description: QoS (0-2) used when subscribing to the topic filters.

properties.name: mes.mqtt.dead-letter-qos
properties.description: QoS (0-2) used when publishing rejected messages to the dead-letter topic.

properties.name: mes.mqtt.session-expiry-interval
properties.description: Seconds the broker keeps the MES session (and its queued QoS 1 messages) after a disconnect. 0 ends the session on disconnect.
